purpose: Bounded public Pretoria/Tshwane parcel qualification using the actual repository ArcGIS adapter in Registered-only single-equality native-ID mode, with viewport/paging, exact-key rereads, absence, footprint, binding, and independent topology audit. No title-deed or ownership fields requested; only three privacy-safe polygons are published.

transport.tls: official GeoTrust TLS RSA CA G1 intermediate appended to rootCertificates; rejectUnauthorized=true

scope.reason: The service WAF returns HTTP 403 for multi-value IN/OR/exclusion predicates. Registered equality query supports count, manifest, and geometry. Now Scheme has 14,864 service-wide records but remains excluded because its legal/current-ground semantics are not defined by service coded domains.

identityCaveat: lis_key is a native string plot reference with a non-unique service index. The 93 observed keys were unique in the bounded sample and each adapter reread resolved to exactly one Registered row; no global uniqueness guarantee is made.

runtime.privacy: outFields contain only OBJECTID, lis_key, parcel_label, status_lu_text, type_lu_text and geometry. Full source geometry remains in /tmp; published sample contains at most three polygons.

identityAudit.exactNativeKeyMode: actual ArcGIS adapter queryIds, idsQueryMode=single-equality, idBatchSize=1

adapterQualification: passed: actual adapter uses idsQueryMode single-equality and idBatchSize 1; exact native keys resolve via equality count/OID manifest then scoped ObjectID geometry reads, with Registered status validated locally.
